title: Agent Companion session status (v1)
description: One file per live agent session, written by an agent integration and read by the Agent Companion app. Agent-neutral: nothing here is specific to any one agent.

pid.description: PID of the long-lived agent process. The app drops the session once this process exits. Omit only if unknown; the app then falls back to an updatedAt staleness timeout.

status.description: working: agent is busy. needs_attention: agent is blocked on the user. idle: finished, waiting for the next prompt. error: last run failed.

task.description: What the session is working on, usually the latest user prompt.

activity.description: Short, live description of the current step.
